name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
benefit: - A pension of ₹300/- per month is provided to Divyangjan between 18-79 years. - A pension of ₹500/- per month will be provided to Divyangjan aged 80 years and above.
_eligibility_text: 1. The age of the applicant should be 18 years and above. 1. The applicant should be a resident of India. 1. The applicant should be a physically or mentally disabled person. 1. The applicant’s disability should be more than 80%. 1. Dwarfs are also eligible for this scheme. 1. The applicant should belong to the below poverty line.
